thread:
maria.chen: Quick sync — dashboard is showing a ~28% drop in webinar -> SAL conversion last week compared to our 4-week baseline. Anyone else seeing this? I'm worried about routing or UTM loss.
kevin.park: Looking into it now. Which webinar id/campaign are you seeing it on?
samir.patel: Which attribution window is the dashboard using? last-touch 7d can hide delayed nurture conversions.
jen.liu: Noticed overall form completions were up but session quality (avg time on page) down for the same webinar landing page. Could be syndication traffic from partner site.
olivia (mktg-ops): I pulled the raw leads in HubSpot — ~12% of the webinar leads have empty utm_source. That's a red flag. The form widget sometimes strips querystring on redirect. cc @engineering if we need a fix. :eyes:
analytics-bot: Ran quick SQL snapshot against leads table for webinar_2026_03_16:
```
SELECT attribution, COUNT(*) as leads
FROM leads
WHERE webinar_id='2026_03_16'
GROUP BY attribution;
-- results: last_touch=243, first_touch=310, blank_utm=54
```
kevin.park: Thanks — looks like blank_utm maps closely to the drop. If blank utm leads are routed into generic nurture, that would lower SAL conversion.
maria.chen: So two parallel issues: lost utm causing misrouting, and potential traffic quality from syndication. Prioritize the utm fix.
j en.liu: Suggests small test: for next webinar leadflow, route unknown-utm leads to a holding queue and enrich via email verification/hidden-field check before normal nurture.
samir.patel: Also recommend we surface both last-touch and multi-touch in the dashboard (30d). I'll add a toggle to the weekly report so we can see whether the conversion gap persists under multi-touch.
olivia (mktg-ops): Ops notes: widget update requires a tiny change to the redirect logic — I can implement + QA in 2 business days. Also, I'll add a "webinar_id" hidden field to the form to reduce reliance on querystring.
maria.chen: Great. Action items: (1) olivia implement hidden field + redirect fix (2d), (2) samir add first-touch and multi-touch views to dashboard (EOD Thu), (3) kevin run a routing audit to map blank_utm leads to existing sequences (EOD Wed), (4) jen run quick quality check on partner referral traffic and ask partner for referrer tags.
kevin.park: I'll also create a short SQL-based report that breaks conversion by utm_source, utm_medium, and "has_webinar_id" flag — will drop in #marketing when ready.
jen.liu: If ops fix is >48h, we should consider temporary routing rule: if webinar landing page form completes and has no utm_source, mark as "probable webinar" and route to SDR queue for high-intent follow-up. Small lift in HubSpot.
maria.chen: Agree. Let's only enable temporary routing if olivia's fix slips past 48h. Can we reconvene Friday 10am to see progress and decide on the temp rule?
olivia (mktg-ops): Yep Friday 10am works. I'll post a PR with the redirect patch today. :thumbsup:
samir.patel: I'll publish the updated dashboard and a short note on methodology changes in the weekly metrics doc so the execs aren't surprised by the different numbers.
analytics-bot: Scheduled report: weekly_leads_snapshot posted to #marketing_reports at 08:00 on Fri.
maria.chen: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. If anyone hits blockers ping me and I'll escalate. :rocket:
